wiki.title: W. Edward Crockett
wiki.extract: W. Edward Crockett is an American businessman and politician who has served as a member of the Maine House of Representatives since December 2018. Elected as a Democrat, he became an independent in 2025 ahead of a brief campaign for Governor of Maine in the 2026 election. He also wrote a memoir for his father, Walter Crockett, and is the president of Capt’n Eli's Soda, a Maine-based soft drink company.
